name: shareroom
description: ShareRoom — compartilhamento de tela em tempo real com salas privadas (WebRTC + LiveKit).

scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run build:helper && npm --prefix desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:dist:preview: npm run build && npm run build:helper && npm --prefix desktop run dist:preview
scripts.desktop:dist:signed: npm run build && npm run build:helper && npm --prefix desktop run dist:signed
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
